packageRules.description: Node 22.22.0 is the documented and supported floor; CI must test the floor rather than only the newest runtime.
@types/node must track the supported floor: engines.node is >=22.22.0, so the types stay on the Node 22 major.
TypeScript 7 is a major compiler change that needs its own migration with a dist-byte comparison, not a dependency bump.
Biome 2.6 reformats YAML front matter in Markdown and rewrites tests/fixtures and examples, so adopting it needs a deliberate fixture-digest and golden review.
